crossRefs.note: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.
For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.
With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.
The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit. He who is under Yahweh’s wrath will fall into it.
A lying tongue hates those it hurts; and a flattering mouth works ruin.
Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! For…
The godly man has perished out of the earth, and there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood…

people.name: Samson
people.line: Israelite judge with great strength from God

translations.web: Delilah said to Samson, “Please tell me where your great strength lies, and what you might be bound to afflict you.”
translations.bsb: So Delilah said to Samson, “Please tell me the source of your great strength and how you can be tied up and subdued.”
translations.kjv: And Delilah said to Samson, Tell me, I pray thee, wherein thy great strength lieth, and wherewith thou mightest be bound to afflict
translations.asv: And Delilah said to Samson, Tell me, I pray thee, wherein thy great strength lieth, and wherewith thou mightest be bound to afflict thee.
